items.title: IG Prime and Investec launch white label offering
items.snippet: IG Prime, the institutional arm of IG Group (a FTSE 100 company), today confirms Investec Prime Services, a business unit within Investec Bank Limited, as a new partner for its institutional white label solution.

items.title: AvaTrade to acquire majority of FXCM's business
items.snippet: AvaTrade, a leading global online trading broker, today announced it has agreed to acquire the majority of FXCM Group’s business, one of the world’s longest-established Forex and CFD trading brands.

items.title: ING opens flagship store in Madrid
items.snippet: ING has inaugurated its new flagship in Madrid, a space that reflects the evolution of the bank in Spain, where it now serves more than four million customers and has established itself as the country’s most recommended bank.

items.title: UK looks to ban non-competes to stop ‘drag on innovation’
EU and UK banks face 1 year deadline for T+1
items.snippet: Banks in the EU and UK are under pressure to demonstrate their operational readiness for the upcoming move to next day settlement, with just one year to go before the deadline for T+1.

items.title: FCA cracks down on finfluencers
items.snippet: The UK's financial watchdog has stepped up its enforcement of illegal 'finfluencer' promotions, resulting in a 7,300% increase in actions between 2023 and 2025.

items.title: New Leaf Network and Twenty7Tec renew partnership
items.snippet: Twenty7tec has renewed its partnership with New Leaf Network for a further three years, extending a long-standing relationship between the two businesses.

items.title: Cavero Secure launches protocol for autonomous AI governance
items.snippet: Cavero Secure, a pioneer in continuous identity security and post-quantum trust architectures, are announcing a breakthrough approach to autonomous AI governance with the launch of its CaveroCTX™ protocol.

items.title: Ex-OpenAI robotics lead’s factory startup in insolvency proceedings
Amex hit with $350m penalty for AML deficiencies
items.snippet: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC), the main banking regulator in the US, has issued a $350m civil money penalty against American Express National Bank for deficiencies in its anti-money laundering (AML) and bank secrecy act (BSA) processes.

items.title: Nivo launches AI assistant for lending
items.snippet: Nivo has today launched Lender Collect, an AI assistant that coordinates a lending case from the first broker email through evidence gathering, underwriting preparation and the conditions that follow the lender's decision.

items.title: DailyPay competes $200m securitisation
items.snippet: DailyPay, the leader in On-Demand Pay, announced a $200 million asset-backed securitisation (ABS) of its On-Demand Pay receivables.

items.title: Sophos cuts threat investigation time by 96% with OpenAI Daybreak
items.snippet: Discover how Sophos uses OpenAI’s Daybreak to cut cyber-threat investigation time by 96% and automate 52% of MDR cases while preserving human oversight.
